note: Schema-2 saves made by the predecessor of package 2 (57ba50f3305d18a0ddcad0d2c3563f14e293d7a7), before the dust clouds, the first aid and the grenade tuning existed (no damage[i].dust, no actor.aid, no timers.aid) and with safeX 250, so the closing lines of the deck assault were other nodes than today's (safeX 190). Control golden route (seed 19390901, support false) unless the entry says `seed`: 04:42:00; 06:05:30 (the assault entering); 06:09:30 (all six men of the assault on a closing line, in a live phase, deck.lim set); the checkpoint cp_m01_d_retirada (deck records of men in phase clear, deck.lim at the deepest line); the same checkpoint of seed 7 (dead men in phase fallback and cover); and the continuation save of the finished act (07:05:00, with its resumeCheckpoint). Package 2 critical review, 2026-11-04: the last four are the ones the first version of the fix refused (`Checkpoint M01 inválido: assalto do tabuleiro de_spans_5`). tests/m01-pkg2-saves.test.js loads them with the live build.
